title: Exterior tensor pairing from a local natural linear map
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $A,B,C$ sheaves of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], $f:A\to B$ a morphism, $r,s,n\in\mathbb N$ with $n=r+s$, and $U\subseteq X$ open. For every $W\subseteq U$ let $t_W:C(W)\to B(W)$ be $\mathcal O_X(W)$-linear, and assume these maps commute with every restriction $W\supseteq Z$. Using exterior sheaves [def-sc-sheaf-exterior-power] and their sheaf tensor product [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product], there exists a natural family of linear maps $d_W:(\bigwedge^r A\otimes\bigwedge^s C)(W)\to(\bigwedge^n B)(W)$ such that $d_W((\bigwedge_i a_i)\otimes(\bigwedge_j c_j))=\bigwedge(f_W(a_1),\ldots,f_W(a_r),t_W(c_1),\ldots,t_W(c_s))$ for all tuples $a\in A(W)^r$ and $c\in C(W)^s$, in this order and reindexed by $n=r+s$. No splitting, exactness, rank or local freeness is assumed, and no uniqueness is asserted.

proof.text: Construct the local bilinear map on the two sectionwise exterior powers by exteriorPower.map for f and t, followed by multiplication in the exterior algebra and the target sheafification unit. Degree membership follows from pow_add and Submodule.mul_mem_mul. Its formula on pure wedges follows from exteriorPower.map_apply_ιMulti and ExteriorAlgebra.ιMulti_mul_ιMulti.

Prove naturality on pure wedges using PresheafOfModules.exteriorPower_map_ιMulti, wedge_map, naturality of f, and ht. Fin.addCases checks the two concatenated blocks separately. Extend to arbitrary inputs by exteriorPower.ιMulti_span and Submodule.span_induction in each factor, using additivity and semilinear restriction scalar identities.

Apply local_bilinear_sheafification_tensor_extension to the exterior presheaves, their local bilinear pairing, and the target exterior sheaf. Its naturality clause is precisely the desired clause. Compose its pure-tensor unit equation with the previously proved pure-wedge formula. Substitute n=r+s; Fin.cast rfl simplifies definitionally.

lean.statement:
theorem exteriorTensor_local_pairing {X : Scheme.{v}} {A B C : X.Modules}
    (f : A ⟶ B) (r n s : ℕ) (hr : n = r + s) (U : X.Opens)
    (t : ∀ W : X.Opens, W ≤ U →
      C.val.obj (op W) →ₗ[X.presheaf.obj (op W)] B.val.obj (op W))
    (ht : ∀ (W Z : X.Opens) (hW : W ≤ U) (hZW : Z ≤ W) b,
      B.val.map (homOfLE hZW).op (t W hW b) =
        t Z (hZW.trans hW) (C.val.map (homOfLE hZW).op b)) :
    ∃ d : ∀ W : X.Opens, W ≤ U →
      (exteriorPower A r ⊗ exteriorPower C s).val.obj (op W)
        →ₗ[X.presheaf.obj (op W)] (exteriorPower B n).val.obj (op W),
      (∀ W hW (a : Fin r → A.val.obj (op W)) (b : Fin s → C.val.obj (op W)),
        d W hW (tmulSection (wedge (M := A) (r := r) (U := W) a)
          (wedge (M := C) (r := s) (U := W) b)) =
        wedge (M := B) (r := n) (U := W)
          (fun i ↦ Fin.append (fun j ↦ f.val.app (op W) (a j))
            (fun j ↦ t W hW (b j)) (Fin.cast hr i))) ∧
      (∀ (W Z : X.Opens) (hW : W ≤ U) (hZW : Z ≤ W) y,
        (exteriorPower B n).val.map (homOfLE hZW).op (d W hW y) =
          d Z (hZW.trans hW)
            ((exteriorPower A r ⊗ exteriorPower C s).val.map (homOfLE hZW).op y))
